business_problem: ElysianNxt needed to replace overnight batch-style risk analysis with a cloud platform that could run large numbers of what-if analyses and regulatory stress tests quickly, while giving customers full lineage and preparing for generative AI–assisted interpretation of risk results.
solution_summary: ElysianNxt built its .NXT risk platform as a cloud-native SaaS architecture on AWS so financial-services customers can run complex risk simulations without overnight batch processing or deep technical setup. The platform runs distributed microservices on Amazon EKS, while Amazon MSK carries near-real-time messages and data between services to support what-if analyses, stress tests, and compliance calculations. This lets customers trace full data lineage from source to result and scale simulations elastically, including IFRS 9 workloads that dropped from 24 hours to less than 1 hour. ElysianNxt is also integrating Amazon Bedrock into the platform to turn results into text-based insights and configurations and to automate data-quality checks. The combination gives customers faster risk analysis today while laying a generative AI foundation inside the same SaaS environment.

solution_components.name: Amazon MSK

solution_components.name: Amazon Bedrock

data_flow: Risk and compliance data moves through distributed microservices on Amazon EKS, is exchanged between services through Amazon MSK for near-real-time processing, and is then surfaced to customers as simulations, stress-test outputs, and emerging Amazon Bedrock-driven text insights and data-quality checks.
business_outcome: Customers can run multiple simulations within minutes, one customer reduced IFRS 9 calculation time from 24 hours to less than 1 hour, and ElysianNxt implemented its Amazon Bedrock assistant to testing in 3 months while maintaining scalable SaaS delivery on AWS.
